title: Black Repertory Group — 25th Anniversary (1990)
description: First-pass gallery of 21 mounted photographs from the Black Repertory Group 25th anniversary album.
gallery_description: Twenty-one preliminary crops from six photographed album pages. Browse by provisional album page, search descriptions, or use the slideshow. Individual dates and identities remain unverified.
notice: Working digitization: several crops still need checking. The album title page dates the anniversary celebration July 20–22, 1990; that does not independently establish each photograph's date. Photographer credits and publication rights remain under review.
credits: From the Jacob Blanchette Jr. Photography Archive; individual photographers not yet verified.
